latest_cos_commentary.headline: Berry AI is a vision-AI analytics platform for QSR drive-thru, dining room and kiosk operations, with a brand-wide 1,000+ location deployment at Culver's announced in 2026.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes on kitchen_drive_thru operational analytics (speed-of-service, throughput, staffing) as a camera-based layer that can sit alongside or compete with drive-thru intelligence features in Genius's kitchen/drive-thru product line.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: The Culver's brand-wide rollout (1,000+ locations) is Berry AI's most significant scale proof point to date as of 2026.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: When a prospect mentions vision-AI or drive-thru analytics, ask whether Berry AI is already piloted — its Culver's win is a credible reference competitors are likely to cite.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: ROI percentage claims (70% comp lift, etc.) are vendor-aggregated across deployments, not single-customer audited results — do not repeat as guaranteed outcomes.
